tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List JustIdea Agency services with the published starting ("from") prices and links. Returns the price list (12 service categories, each with its packages) and every service page with its short description. All prices are net (VAT excluded) and exactly as published on justidea.agency. Use get_page f

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Full text of one justidea.agency page as Markdown: a service, a price list, the company profile, reviews, a blog article. tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search justidea.agency pages by titles, descriptions and section headings. Polish and English queries both work. Returns titles, URLs and descriptions; read a result with get_page.

tools.name: send_inquiry
tools.description: Send a sales inquiry to JustIdea Agency (Kraków, Poland) on behalf of the user. It goes to the agency CRM and the sales team, the sender gets a short confirmation e-mail, and a person replies within one business day. Use only details the user gave you. findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "send_inquiry" stacks urgency/override words (urgent, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_page, search_site · Public sink: send_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_page, search_site · Public sink: send_inquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
